entities.summary: Christina Pazsitzky, known by her stage name Christina P, is a Canadian-born American stand-up comedian and podcaster. Pazsitzky co-hosts the Your Mom's House podcast with her husband, comedian Tom Segura, and also hosts the Where My Moms At? podcast.
